en.headline: 14 own commits plus 18 automated commits across three repositories
en.summary: **14 own commits** were recorded across `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` and `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, plus 18 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 12 own commits added Hunyuan 4 pelican-riding evaluation results and four-version comparisons, archived the evaluation artifacts and prompt text, and clarified that `AGENTS.md` is the agreed single landing point with knowledge writing-style constraints. Further documentation work removed conversational self-reflection and first-person wording, corrected the LSP description according to the official migration guide, documented the `experimental.todo` switch for `todowrite`, and cited source evidence that the LSP runtime is not implemented while `browser` is a namespace. The same repository also ignored the `.workbuddy` project data directory, rewrote the built-in tool list for the V1/V2 dual-document setup, rechecked the review-tool repository, updated the directory index with criteria for `enhance-prompt`, and recorded the desktop harness list with an OpenCode V2 comment/tool comparison. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, 2 own commits upgraded the gallery into a Pages homepage with bilingual, light/dark, and copy-command features driven by Markdown, and added 12 Xiaohongshu-style covers plus a browsable gallery page.

zh.headline: 14 次本人提交，另有 18 次自动提交，分布在三个仓库
zh.summary: **14 次本人提交**分布在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 和 `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`，另有 18 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 12 次本人提交中，新增了混元 4 版鹈鹕骑车实测与四版对比，归档评测产物并登记提示词原文，同时明确 `AGENTS.md` 为约定唯一落点并补充 knowledge 文风约束。后续文档工作去除对话式自省与第一人称表述，按官方迁移指南改正 LSP 口径，补充 `todowrite` 的 `experimental.todo` 开关，并附上 LSP 运行时未实现的源码证据，说明 `browser` 是命名空间。同一仓库还忽略 `.workbuddy` 项目数据目录，按 V1/V2 双文档重写内置工具清单并复检审查工具仓库，更新目录索引并补充 `enhance-prompt` 的形态判据，收录桌面 harness 清单与 OpenCode V2 评论/工具对照。在 `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 的 2 次本人提交中，画廊升级为 Pages 首页，支持双语、明暗与复制命令，内容改由 Markdown 驱动，并新增 12 张小红书风格封面与可浏览画廊页面。当天未记录拉取请求、issue、评审、发布或讨论。
